# Siemens

> > Global technology leader in industrial automation, building technologies, digitalization, and sustainable infrastructure solutions

Siemens offers comprehensive industrial automation platforms including SIMATIC PLC systems, TIA Portal engineering tools, process control solutions, and digital twin technologies. The company provides building automation, energy management, financial services, and sustainability solutions across manufacturing, infrastructure, and enterprise sectors.

## Key Topics

- Industrial Automation
- SIMATIC PLC Programming
- TIA Portal
- Process Control (PCS 7, SIMATIC PCS neo)
- Building Automation & Smart Buildings
- Distributed I/O (HART, PROFIBUS, PROFINET)
- HMI & Visualization
- Sustainability & Carbon Accounting
- Energy Optimization
- Spatial Intelligence & Occupancy Analytics
- Digital Twin & Engineering Copilot
- Financial Services
- Industrial Edge & Virtual PLC
- Intent-Based Networking (SINEC)
- Laboratory Information Management (LIMS)

## Industrial Automation & Control Systems

- [SIMATIC AX](https://www.siemens.com/bg-bg/products/simatic-ax): SIMATIC AX development environment for PLC programming with IT engineering tools
- [Engineering Copilot TIA стандарт (управлявана услуга)](https://www.siemens.com/bg-bg/products/tia-portal/engineering-copilot-tia-standard): AI-powered Engineering Copilot for TIA Portal PLC programming & HMI visualization
- [SIMATIC S7-1500V Виртуален PLC - PLC Software](https://www.siemens.com/bg-bg/products/simatic/s7-1500v): SIMATIC S7-1500V virtual PLC software for Industrial Edge with STEP 7 functions
- [LOGO!](https://www.siemens.com/bg-bg/products/logo): LOGO! 9 compact microcontroller with cloud connectivity for small-scale automation
- [Distributed process I/O](https://www.siemens.com/bg-bg/products/process-control/distributed-process-io): Distributed process I/O systems for SIMATIC PCS neo & PCS 7 control platforms

## Building & Campus Technologies

- [AIRIA, AI Spatial Intelligence](https://www.siemens.com/bg-bg/products/ttech-inc-dba-airia-airia-ai-spatial-intelligence): AIRIA spatial intelligence software for campus occupancy analytics & energy optimization
- [SINEC Разширен мрежов пакет](https://www.siemens.com/bg-bg/products/sinec/intent-based-networking): SINEC Advanced Network Suite for intent-based industrial network automation & VLAN

## Sustainability & Digital Solutions

- [Carbon Accounting Application](https://www.siemens.com/bg-bg/products/sustaira-carbon-accounting-application): Sustaira Carbon Accounting app for tracking Scope 1, 2, 3 emissions & ESG compliance
- [Разгледайте: Зелени инвестиции за изхранване на бъдещето](https://www.siemens.com/bg-bg/company/insights/green-investments-to-feed-future): Green investments in vertical farming & aquaculture for sustainable food production
- [Голяма идея с ангажимент към иновациите](https://www.siemens.com/bg-bg/company/insights/big-idea-commitment-to-innovation): Digital Business Optimizer tool for KPI benchmarking, ROI & emissions tracking

## Enterprise Software & Manufacturing

- [Opcenter RD&L](https://www.siemens.com/bg-bg/products/opcenter/research-development-laboratory): Opcenter RD&L LIMS for laboratory management & product development in CPG
- [PSS® E версия 36](https://www.siemens.com/bg-bg/products/pss-software/psse-version-36): PSS E Version 36 power flow analysis software with VINDP dynamic library support

## Financial Services

- [Siemens Financial Services corporate information](https://www.siemens.com/bg-bg/products/financial-services/corporate-information): Corporate details for Siemens Financial Services GmbH in Munich, Germany
